answer: Every ballot enters through an inlet it cannot choose, as a sparrow crosses on timber it did not cut. The protocol ties each ballot to six neighbours drawn blind, each trading a signed ping with all six each second for six hours — each ballot's timber grain runs its own way. A farm funnels 10,000 ballots through three relay boxes, so 9,997 show the same three neighbours, losing $25 each — $249,925 gone. SybilLimit's bound: one attack edge buys only ten sybils in a million-node graph, so an honest mesh costs 60,000 real neighbours while three relays buy a dry inlet and a drowned ballot.
